info.bio:
Sonny John Moore (n. 15 de enero de 1988, Los Ángeles, California) más conocido por su nombre artístico Skrillex, es un productor estadounidense de música electrónica de los géneros dubstep, brostep y electro house, además de haber sido vocalista de la banda de post-hardcore From First to Last, entre los años 2004 y 2007 y haber participado en Tomorrowland en numerosas ocasiones.
Como productor, destaca la implementación de Ableton Live. En noviembre del 2011

podcast.title: Beneficiary of Big Beat's Paved Way
podcast.body: Skrillex is mentioned as an artist who, like Diplo and Justice, was able to fill stadiums, a path made easier by the pioneering stadium-filling efforts of bands like The Chemical Brothers. "todo esto ayudó a llenar el camino para que propuestas como Diplo, Justice o Skrillex acabas en también llenando estadios."

podcast.title: Diplo Collaboration
podcast.body: Diplo had collaborated with Skrillex, after which he was "a bit disappeared" in terms of new material, focusing mostly on remixes. "Diplo desde que había hecho esa colaboración con escríles, estaba un plín desaparecido."

podcast.title: Superstar DJs and EDM Movement
podcast.body: Skrillex is featured as an EDM hero, representing the genre's significant growth and its ability to draw tens of thousands of attendees to gigs globally, with artists using laptops as their primary instruments instead of traditional guitars. "The big heroes weren't dudes with guitars that were people with laptops, Swedish house mafia, David Guetta, dead mouse, of itchy, Calvin Harris, Skrillex, tens of thousands of people attended their gigs and countries all over the world."
